items.title: Adobe acquires Indian AI startup Rilo
items.summary: Adobe has acquired Rilo, an AI startup founded in 2025 by IIT Bombay alumni, in an undisclosed deal — another sign of global tech majors picking up Indian AI talent and products.

items.title: Noida startup YoLearn.ai raises seed round for AI tutoring in 22 Indian languages
items.summary: YoLearn.ai, a voice-first AI tutoring platform aligned to CBSE, ICSE and state boards, raised a seed round led by ABP Education. Students scan a textbook code to get step-by-step help in their own language.

items.title: Creedom raises Rs 4.1 crore for its AI growth coach for content creators
items.summary: Creedom, an AI-powered growth coach aimed at content creators, closed a seed round backed by a mix of corporate executives and startup founders.

items.title: New York City limits AI tools for students through grade 8
items.summary: New York City has introduced restrictions on AI tool use for younger students, adding to a growing national debate on how classrooms should handle AI as it becomes more common in everyday life.

items.title: Sony Music and Warner Chappell sue Anthropic over song lyrics
items.summary: Two major music publishers have filed a lawsuit alleging an AI model was trained on copyrighted song lyrics without permission, seeking significant damages per song — the latest in a wave of AI copyright cases.

items.title: Apple names John Ternus as its new CEO
items.summary: Apple has a new chief executive, taking charge of one of the only major tech companies without its own frontier AI model — a gap likely to shape his early priorities.

items.title: EU begins treating ChatGPT under search-engine rules
items.summary: European regulators have started applying search-engine-style oversight to ChatGPT, adding a new layer of accountability for how AI chatbots surface information online.

items.title: Microsoft 365 outage traced to a shared authentication issue
items.summary: A widespread outage hit Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive and Microsoft 365 Copilot this week, with Microsoft pointing to a core authentication problem shared across products — a reminder of how interconnected cloud tools have become.

items.title: Anthropic secures $35B in Nvidia-backed compute capacity in Texas
items.summary: A major new compute deal underscores how much raw processing power today's AI race demands — and how central chip supply has become to every AI lab's roadmap.

items.title: Critical Langflow vulnerability actively exploited by attackers
items.summary: Security researchers report active attacks on a serious flaw (CVE-2026-0768) in Langflow, a popular open-source framework for building AI agents, with attackers attempting to steal API keys and cloud credentials from exposed servers.

items.title: Google tightens usage limits on Gemini Notebook
items.summary: Google is rolling out compute-based usage limits on Gemini Notebook, following similar moves by other AI vendors as demand for AI tools continues to outpace available capacity.
